lines.text: G'day, how's the back since last time?
Since last time the pain's been running down into my left buttock.
Hard to tell, to be honest.
Any tingling or numbness in the leg?
Let me have a look. Straight leg raise is about seventy on both sides, so the nerve's not too cranky.
I think you have a bit of irritation in the joint at the base of the spine, probably from all the driving.
Get out of the ute every hour on long trips and walk around it twice, no worries if people stare.
Righto, no worries, see ya next Tuesday.
G'day mate, come on in, grab a seat.
Thanks. My knee's been swelling up after cricket, it's the right one.
